Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended 
(“Listing Regulations”)– – Receipt of Letter of Acceptance (LOA) 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of SEBI (Listing Obligations and 
Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and SEBI Circular dated November 11, 
2024, we are pleased to inform that Mayasheel Ventures Limited (in Joint 
Venture with M/s JSP Projects Pvt. Ltd.) has received a Letter of Acceptance 
(LOA) for a significant infrastructure project in the State of Arunachal Pradesh. 
As per the LOA, the details of the project are as follows: 
 
Project Name: Construction of road from km 0.00 to km 27.430 (Package 1) 
of Bile Miging section of NH-913 (Frontier Highway) to Intermediate Lane on 
EPC mode in the State of Arunachal Pradesh 
 
Awarding Authority: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) 
 
Nature of Contract: EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) 
 
Order Value: ₹3,06,53,00,000/- (Rupees Three Hundred Six Crore Fifty-Three 
Lakh Only), excluding GST 
 
Mode of Award: Through tender process; accepted as lowest evaluated 
responsive bid 
 
Time Period: 36 months 
The bid for the aforesaid project was submitted in a Joint Venture (JV) with M/s JSP 
Projects Pvt. Ltd., wherein Mayasheel Ventures Limited is the Lead Member. The 
execution of the project shall be primarily carried out by Mayasheel Ventures Limited 
in accordance with the terms of the JV agreement.  
This order strengthens the Company’s position in the highway and border 
infrastructure segment, particularly in strategically significant regions, and aligns with 
its growth strategy in EPC civil works.

Further, details as required under Regulation 30 read with SEBI Circular dated 
November 11, 2024 are enclosed herewith as Annexure A. 
This intimation is also being made available on the website of the Company at: 
https://mayasheelventures.com/ 
You are requested to kindly take the same on record. 
Thanking You,  
Yours faithfully, 
For Mayasheel Ventures Limited 
(Formerly known as Mayasheel Construction) 
 
 
 
Neelam Rani 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer 
M. No. A74136
